jev:profile:S-2:Pure assertion—makes a truth-claim that could be denied.
jev:profile:S-2:Balanced—asserts and points in equal measure.
jev:profile:S-2:Pure ostension—directs attention without asserting anything.
jev:profile:S-1:truth:Collapses immediately—the self-application produces contradiction or emptiness.
jev:profile:S-1:truth:Oscillates—the self-application alternates between two states without settling.
jev:profile:S-1:truth:Degrades—the self-application produces a weakened or partial version of the original.
jev:profile:S-1:truth:Holds—the self-application reproduces the distinction without change.
jev:profile:S-1:truth:Strengthens—the self-application reveals the distinction to be more fundamental than before.
